renames.evidence: Instance methods compare candidate text with the current text of field_i, propagate its nl validation result, and return createMismatchAlertText on mismatch. qh installs it on the confirmation field, and mk composes it for a second matching field. Unrelated static helpers retain independent method identities.

Abstract instance contract supplies validation state and message for field_g current text; constructor captures that text input, e(int) delegates to a(int,String), and b(byte) delegates to b(int,String). Static game helpers are unrelated to this instance role.
Constructor parameter 1 is stored here. Both validation methods compare candidate text with this input's current field_s and inspect its existing nl validator before accepting a match.
Constructor captures the input whose current field_s is passed into the abstract validation methods by e(int) and b(byte).
Reused outer loop index for corner border layers and positions along edge strips; role is deliberately broad across those separate loops.
Reused for the initial slice-array traversal, square-corner scan positions and edge-band offsets; not named as one fixed x/y coordinate.
Current sprite selected from slicesToFill before its complete pixel array is initialized.
Indexes the current sprite pixel array during the initial fill-colour loop.
Snapshot of Geoblox.field_C. Nonzero paths change loop transfers, so the source retains this guard rather than assuming normal-play zero.
Sum of innerAccentWidth, borderGap and outerBorderWidth; used as both dimensions of the four square corners and the transverse dimension of edge strips.
Nine newly allocated sprites; pixel writes use row-major indices 0..8, and this array is returned.
Alias of the returned slices array used by the initial full-pixel-fill traversal.

review.evidence: Inspected n.a pixel writes, tf.a fixed geometry and wa.a border installation; inspected q instance wrappers, n equality/validation logic, qh confirmation-field installation and mk composition. Every addition matches the pinned javac declaration identity and original spelling. Shared generated stack carriers and unrelated static resource roles remain unnamed. The complete q candidate-state/message override families are renamed consistently across all seven declarations; asynchronous and pending semantics are preserved.
